about.title: About me
about.body1: I'm an email development professional. I live between tables, VML for Outlook and media queries. My obsession: a newsletter looking perfect on an iPhone and on desktop Outlook 2016.
about.body2: Why I do it: email is still the highest-ROI channel. Broken HTML costs money. I close the gap between design and inbox with clean, tested, accessible code.
